messages.subject: Usage tracking on spark
parts:
Does anyone know the best practice for usage tracking for a shiny app on spark? We have looked into google analytics, but it looks like people have had problems in the past. Are these fixed? Google analytics is also imperfect because I really just need a log with user ip address (to track unique users) and whether or not they got errors.

Thanks,

Jonathon
